commands.summary: Plan and execute the create scraping job reverse-ETL action
examples: pm web-scrapper create scraping job apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: starts a real scraping run against the sitemap's (or start_urls override's) target site(s); consumes page credits from the caller's Web Scraper Cloud account for every page scraped
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create sitemap reverse-ETL action
examples: pm web-scrapper create sitemap apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new sitemap (scraper configuration) in the caller's Web Scraper Cloud account; low-risk, does not itself start scraping any site
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete scraping job reverse-ETL action
examples: pm web-scrapper delete scraping job apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a scraping job and its scraped data; any already-downloaded export is unaffected, but the job's stored records become unrecoverable through the API
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete sitemap reverse-ETL action
examples: pm web-scrapper delete sitemap apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a sitemap; any scraping job history tied to it is not itself deleted but the configuration can no longer be reused or edited
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
